content:
Best Buy has refreshed its massive 60th anniversary sale with more new deals, as we continue to track the 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the lowest price ever on AirTag 2. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also includes: a massive $500 price drop on this 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at Amazon, Anker's latest SmartTrack Find My wallet card dropping to a new all-time low of $25, and Mint Mobile launching a crazy 50% off promotion with unlimited talk/data plans for just $15/month for a year. See all the deals below.

Best Buy 60th anniversary sale refreshed with a new batch of deals: TVs from $110, tech up to 50% off, $1,000 off appliances, and more

AirPods deals get even more price cuts, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, plus more

After a whole summer of steady deals on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, they've all gotten even more price cuts. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now on sale for 25% off, hitting one of the best prices ever, but at the same time the ANC-equipped AirPods 4 have dropped to their lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 got another $120 price cut this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (regularly $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (regularly $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regularly $129)

Extremely rare deal: M4 Mac mini drops $150 today via the official Apple Certified Refurbished store

Update: This deal has sold out, we'll keep a close eye on restocks.

There have already been plenty of great deals on the AirPods Pro 3 and latest AirTag 2, M5 MacBook Pro models, and more, but the latest M4 Mac mini has been notoriously hard to come by. It's been on sale plenty at retailers like Amazon and Best Buy before, but has been nearly impossible to find. We've now spotted an extremely rare chance to pick up this 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini for $150 off via the official Apple Certified Refurbished store.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished store is now selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849 with free shipping.

Lower price drops: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro gets massive $500 price cut at Amazon

This week has brought some notable fresh $400 discounts on M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations as part of a special one-day Apple event. But we wanted to specifically spotlight one of those models — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now down $500 at Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB internal SSD for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the $3,199 configuration that comes with the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (rather than the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU version that's down $400 right now). Even though this model just experienced a price hike, its current price is still $100 below the older, lower MSRP.

Both options are good depending on what kind of performance you need — now down $400 and $500, respectively. The upgraded CPU/GPU usually costs an extra $200, but with our current deals you only pay $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (regularly $2,999) with 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (regularly $3,199) with 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We expect this $500 price drop won't last long, but it's hard to say whether it will hold through Sunday when the main promotion event of the week ends.

Apple's latest AirTag 2 hits all-time low at Amazon this week, but here's how to get one for $20

Apple deals keep rolling in this week, with AirPods Pro 3 still enjoying 25% off pricing and the latest AirPods Max 2 seeing one of their biggest price cuts yet at $120. Alongside the $500 price drop on select M5 Pro MacBook Pro models, some more noteworthy deals have also landed on their latest AirTag 2 trackers, with both the single and 4-packs back at their all-time low prices — but now you can also grab one for as low as $20.

Amazon has now dropped the AirTag 2 single and 4-packs to the lowest prices we've tracked since they launched earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (regularly $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (regularly $99)

That works out to just $22.25 per tag for the 4-pack, while the single AirTag 2 is back at its Prime Day all-time low of $24.

While it's not a huge difference, it's worth noting that Best Buy's 'Premium' open-box single AirTag 2 listings are also at the lowest prices we've tracked — you can snag one for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 'Premium' open-box $20 (regularly $29 new) | Best Buy

While that price is only $4 less than the new one at Amazon, and I'd personally rather just get the new one, it is indeed the lower price. Best Buy also has the same deal on new stock, so if you're already placing an order to take part in their ongoing 60th anniversary sale, it's worth checking out the selection there.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week $100 price drop, Best Buy open-box deals from $254

Anker's latest SmartTrack Find My wallet card with iOS or Android support drops to new all-time low of $25 at Amazon

Anker recently launched its all-new SmartTrack Find My Card for your wallet — its first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — and it's now dropped to a new all-time low of $25 at Amazon with free shipping for Prime members.

Anker's official EufyHome storefront at Amazon is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 (supports iOS or Android) for $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

When it first landed at Amazon last month it carried a $35 price tag, then got a slight $5 price cut later in the month, and now it's seeing its first significant price drop for a new all-time low at Amazon.

What you're looking at now is nearly a 30% discount, matching the better deals on similar wallet tracker cards we've seen this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards — they start at $35, with the Pro model featuring a 16-month battery life (then needs to be recharged) priced at $45 — but no matter which one you choose, I think everyone should have one in their wallet or card holder. I never leave the house without mine.

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the most important features, including wireless charging, while being compatible with both the Apple Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It's 1.7mm thin, has a ring volume of up to 80dB for tracking it when it's nearby — and of course you can also pull it up on a map directly through the Find My and Find Hub apps.

Mint Mobile now running crazy 50% off promotion, unlimited talk/data 1-year plan just $15/month

Mint Mobile is now running some crazy promotions on its unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plans. While this carrier offers solid value most of the year round, right now their unlimited 12-month plan is just $15/month — that's 50% off, or just $180 for a year of unlimited talk, text, and data service. Even if you're not looking to switch your main phone plan right now, the price is low enough to consider as a backup line or for your iPad.

While its 17GB and 23GB plans are also discounted, the best deal here is the 5G/4G LTE Plan: 12 months of unlimited talk/data service for just $15/month.

  • Mint Mobile unlimited 12-month plan $15/month (50% off)

Per the fine print here, you'll need to pay the $180 12-month plan fee up front (which works out to $15 per month), but for anyone looking to switch to a new carrier at a discount or add an extra line for another device / as a backup, this is a seriously deep discount.

If your phone supports eSIM, you can 'activate service instantly' and it works with all kinds of Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. You can keep your existing number and bring your own unlocked phone to the service if needed.

Head over to the deals page to learn more.

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low at Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also on sale)

As part of their late-summer series of deals on Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear, Amazon is also offering the lowest price ever on the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro, and has brought back the Prime Day all-time low on the wired model — both at nearly 30% off the original price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (regularly $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (regularly $250)

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker's MagSafe power banks start at $36 with free shipping this week (lots of colors available)
  • Anker's 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is one of the best options out there, now 35% off (hits all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the nicest MagSafe stands I've seen, grab it for just $27 (regularly $35)
  • Twelve South's versatile braided PowerCord USB-C charger now just $16.50 (55% off)
  • Anker's Nano 100W 3-port charger comes with a 5-foot cable included, today just $36
  • Woot's massive PC sale now live, up to 75% off desktop gaming rigs, monitors, coolers, and more from $5
  • This compact SSD enclosure with display features power loss protection, today just $29
  • Razer's portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub just dropped to new all-time low of $52 (43% off)
  • Twelve South's Find My-equipped USB-C wall charger just dropped to new all-time low at Amazon, under $37
  • Wow! These leather Apple Watch bands are just $6 with Prime shipping (75% off)

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 down $120 (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary sale has brought one of the best prices yet on Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with all five colors now enjoying a $120 price drop from the original price at Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Priced the same as the previous generation's $549, you can now save a solid $120 — the best price you can find on a new model from a reputable retailer right now.

Best Buy has the Midnight Black version in 'Premium' open-box condition for $403.99 with free shipping, which is indeed cheaper, but may not be low enough to justify giving up a brand new model.

Apple released a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, rather than just a minor revision that swapped the shell and added a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear option won't be updated at next month's new product launch, so we're getting the latest Apple over-ear headphones at a $120 discount now — probably for quite a long time.

Only one previous sales event offered a lower price — Prime Day earlier this summer, when these were selling for $30 less than today's price — and inventory during that 4-day sale was quite limited and inconsistent.

Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models now $220 off (matching Prime Day deals)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished store is my top recommendation for getting deals on iPhones, Apple isn't currently selling their latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet — it seems that'll have to wait until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed listings are now back at Prime Day prices, up to $220 off the brand new original price.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed models have been hands-down the best way to grab an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro so far. Not only do you save hundreds of dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'greater than 90% original battery life' — the non-'Premium' Renewed and certified refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty, and you won't get the same level of battery life either.

Right now you can find 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models back in stock, up to $220 off — with the 512GB version coming in $20 cheaper than we've previously mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (regularly $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (regularly $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (regularly $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (regularly $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (regularly $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (regularly $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Certified Refurbished store featured roundup, you can pick up a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model from $699 with a 1-year Apple warranty; the 1TB 16 Pro Max is just $1,269 — that's $330 less than the equivalent 17 Pro Max and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Certified Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)

Anker's 45W Nano smart display charger is still holding at $26, but this bundle throws in a USB-C cable for just $4 more
